app_subtitle: Checks whether a document is genuine or tampered with (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
folder_saved: CSV report saved to the folder.
exp_temiz: This document appears to be authored normally. No clear signs of tampering.
exp_supheli: This document shows signs of tampering/processing. Review it manually.
exp_supheli_strong: This document shows strong signs of tampering/processing. Review it manually.
exp_supheli_mid: This document shows signs of tampering/processing. Review it carefully.
exp_dikkat: There are minor suspicious signs. Worth a closer look.
w_app_lib: The document appears to be produced by a programming library (application: {app}); it may not have been typed by a human. Review MANUALLY for automated / possible AI generation.
w_app_sahte_word: The application claims '{app}' but there are no editing traces (RSID) in the document; it may not have been typed in Word but produced by a tool. REVIEW MANUALLY.
w_app_bilinmeyen: The document does not appear to be produced by a known Office editor (application: {app}); review manually.
w_app_yok: No creating-application information; the document may not have been saved by a standard editor, review manually.
w_hizli_yazim: The document appears to be written in a very short time (TotalTime={dk} min, {kelime} words; ~{hiz} words per minute). This cannot be typed by hand at that rate; the content may have been PASTED from elsewhere (copy-paste or AI text). Not definitive, REVIEW MANUALLY.
w_time_zero: TotalTime=0 but there are {kelime} words; editing time was reset, review manually.
help_p1: Tespit checks whether a Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx) or PowerPoint (.pptx) document has been tampered with. It does not read the visible content, but inspects the hidden metadata inside (editing traces, dates, creating application, counters) and looks for inconsistencies.
help_p2:
1) Click 'Select Document and Check' and pick a file.
2) A large colored result box appears within seconds.
3) To check every document in a folder at once, use 'Scan Folder'; the result is saved to the folder as a CSV report you can open in Excel.
help_p3:
• GREEN / CLEAN: The document appears normally authored.
• RED / SUSPICIOUS: The document shows tampering/processing traces; review manually.
• ORANGE WARNING: The document seems produced by a tool or written in a very short time (content pasted, possible AI text). Not a definitive verdict, a hint for closer review.
help_p4:
• The result is not definitive proof, but a strong indicator. Always review suspicious documents manually.
• A 'Clean' result does not prove that no AI was used: if someone wrote the text elsewhere and pasted it into Word, the file can look perfectly clean.
• The 'Technical Report' button shows all details.
help_p5: Below the result, the program that created the document is shown. This helps tell whether it was authored in an editor or produced by a tool.
